summary.content:
Today's selection covers 50 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 28 on Artificial Intelligence and 10 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra can find zero-days, but is also harder to monitor
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Scammers demand ransoms from Instagram users over fake copyright claims
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 28 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.title: Scammers demand ransoms from Instagram users over fake copyright claims
top.description: Users say they are losing money or risk having their accounts suspended because Meta struggles to identify scammers.

top.title: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra can find zero-days, but is also harder to monitor
top.description: OpenAI confirmed that GPT-6 Astra is the first model it has broadly deployed to reach the "Critical level" for cybersecurity capabilities. [...]

top.title: OpenAI chief scientist warns no-one is prepared for consequences of AI
top.description: The post comes as the firm releases GPT-6 Astra, which it says is its most powerful product yet.

top.title: Early Data Indicates an A.I.-Generated Drug Could Slow Aging
top.description: Artificial intelligence was used to help develop a drug candidate, rentosertib, for a rare lung condition. Its maker says the drug also seems to reduce the biological hallmarks of age.
